physical_meaning: Mean brightness level in r band across the reconstructed light curve.
interpretation: Average r-band brightness encodes scale information beyond a single peak snapshot.

physical_meaning: Observed temporal coverage of the transient.
interpretation: Observed temporal coverage contributes because different classes occupy different effective time windows.

physical_meaning: Peak brightness scale in z band.
interpretation: Band-specific peak brightness is a strong classifier signal, consistent with transient luminosity structure.

physical_meaning: Peak brightness scale in i band.
interpretation: i-band peak brightness contributes strongly to separating Ia from non-Ia events.

physical_meaning: Color near peak from the r-to-i flux ratio.
interpretation: r-i color acts as a spectral-slope proxy near peak.

physical_meaning: Variability or spread of reconstructed i-band flux values.
interpretation: i-band variability helps capture light-curve shape, not just scale.

physical_meaning: Color near peak from the g-to-r flux ratio.
interpretation: Color near peak captures temperature or spectral-slope differences characteristic of Ia evolution.

physical_meaning: Mean brightness level in g band across the reconstructed light curve.
interpretation: Mean g-band brightness adds complementary information to peak-only brightness proxies.

physical_meaning: Peak-to-trough amplitude in the i band.
interpretation: i-band amplitude reflects how strongly the light curve rises and falls around peak.

physical_meaning: Color near peak from the i-to-z flux ratio.
interpretation: i-z color contributes to distinguishing redder or later-phase light-curve behavior.

physical_meaning: Peak brightness scale in r band.
interpretation: r-band peak brightness remains informative even after compact pruning.

physical_meaning: Variability or spread of reconstructed z-band flux values.
interpretation: Spread in z-band flux captures shape or variability around peak.

physical_meaning: Time of peak in r band.
interpretation: Peak timing in r band reflects band-lag physics and phase structure.

physical_meaning: Time of peak in z band.
interpretation: Inter-band timing helps capture peak-lag structure in the transient.

physical_meaning: Time of peak in i band.
interpretation: Peak timing in i band contributes to the time-evolution signature of Ia light curves.

physical_meaning: Variability or spread of reconstructed r-band flux values.
interpretation: r-band spread adds another light-curve-shape cue after pruning redundant amplitudes.
